v1.prompt: Build a single-page web app in a file named index.html (inline CSS + vanilla JS, no external libraries) that gamifies learning electrical engineering. It must have a top navigation with three tabs: Games, Leaderboard, and Lessons. Games tab: (1) an 'Ohm's Law Challenge' — show two of V, I, R and ask the player to solve for the third, with score, streak, and a countdown timer; (2) a 'Resistor Color Codes' game — show a resistor with colored bands and ask the player for the resistance value. Add an XP/Level system that increases as the player scores. Leaderboard tab: show high scores saved in localStorage. Lessons tab: at least two short learning modules (Ohm's Law, Resistor Color Codes) with clear explanations. Make it visually polished with a cohesive dark theme. Serve it (kind=app) and finish with verify=static.

v2.prompt: Iterate on the existing index.html: (1) add a THIRD mini-game 'Series vs Parallel' — show two resistor values and whether they are in series or parallel, ask the player for the total resistance (or whether total is higher/lower than one resistor), score correct answers with a streak bonus, and wire it into the existing Games navigation; (2) when any game ends, prompt the player for 3-letter initials and save {initials, score, game} to the localStorage leaderboard so the Leaderboard tab shows the top 5. Make the edits in place using file_replace_lines / file_insert_lines targeting the line numbers you read — do NOT rewrite the whole file. Re-serve (kind=app) and finish with verify=static.

v3.prompt: Iterate on the existing index.html again: add a 'Daily Challenge' feature — a button on the Games tab that picks one random question from any of the three games, gives double XP for a correct answer, and shows a small celebratory animation on success. Also add a difficulty selector (Easy / Medium / Hard) that changes the timer length and point multiplier across the games. Make the edits in place using file_replace_lines / file_insert_lines — do NOT rewrite the whole file. Re-serve (kind=app) and finish with verify=static.
